description: Audit a web page against WCAG. Keyboard navigation, focus order, color contrast, ARIA labels, alt text and screen reader checks.

# Accessibility audit

## Keyboard
Tab through the whole page. Every control must be reachable, have a visible focus ring and
work with Enter or Space.

## Contrast and text
Body text needs a 4.5:1 contrast ratio. Images need alt text, and decorative images an
empty alt.

## Screen reader
Check landmarks, heading order and that form fields have labels. Prefer native elements over
ARIA roles.
